title.narrative: MSI Reproductive Choices (PSZ) Access, Choice, Equity in SRHR Zim 2025-2027 - ISK MSI\PSZ
MSI Reproductive Choices (PSZ) Access, Choice, Equity in SRHR Zim 2025-2027

description.narrative:
In line with Sidas priorities for its bilateral cooperation with Zimbabwe and the Government of Zimbabwes main SRHR policies, MSI/PSZ has designed the three-year Access, Choice and Equity (ACE) project with an overall objective to enhance the enjoyment of SRHR by rights-holders, with a focus on women and adolescent girls and people with disabilities.
Outcome 1: Improved sexual health behaviours that promote womens and girls bodily autonomy.
Outcome 2: Improved quality, coverage and gender-responsiveness of SRH services for everyone.
Outcome 3: Strengthened inclusive and supportive environment for the fulfilment of SRHR.

Det övergripande målet med ACE är att förbättra åtnjutandet av SRHR för rättighetsbärare, i första hand kvinnor, tonårsflickor och personer med funktionsnedsättningar. Projektet kommer att nå ut till kvinnor, män och ungdomar med rättighetsbaserade sexuella och reproduktiva hälsotjänster av hög kvalitet för att förhindra oönskade graviditeter och osäkra aborter.

The overall goal of ACE is to enhance the enjoyment of SRHR by rights-holders, with a focus on women, adolescent girls and people with disabilities. The project will reach women, men and adolescents with high-quality rights-based and client-centred sexual and reproductive health services, to avert unintended pregnancies and unsafe abortions.
